title: From Automation to Co-Creation
content:
As AI is transforming not only how we create products but also what these products should be, this talk given at UX Strat focuses on the latter: how to rethink the type of products we build.

Most conversations about AI in product development centre on automation — using AI to make existing processes faster or cheaper. This talk takes a different angle, arguing that the more important question is whether the nature of the products we build should change entirely.

Key themes

  • The shift from automation to co-creation: AI as a collaborator rather than a tool
  • How generative AI opens up new categories of products that weren't possible before
  • What product teams should be asking themselves today to stay ahead of the curve
  • Rethinking product–user relationships in an era of adaptive, personalised experiences

About the talk

This talk was presented at the UX Strat conference. Thanks to Paul Bryan from UX Strat for the support in putting this together.

Speaker: Remko Vermeulen, VP & Head of Product
